content.what_it_is: MATLAB figure script for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_frf_abc_data case: plots the model bathymetry with numbered gauge-station markers over the FRF Google Earth image and exports jpg/eps. It reads station indices (columns i,j) from ../work/station.txt (L11-L13), reads binary single-precision dep.out with dims [m n]=[660 800] and reorients via transpose+flipud+fliplr (L16-L22), loads frf_03.jpg (L26), registers coordinates x=[1:m]*1.+105, y=[n:-1:1]*1.0+220 (L29-L31), sets up a 6x8-inch jet-colormap figure (L33-L38), NaNs land cells dep<0 (L46), draws the rotated image with pcolor(X,Y,-dep) on top (L48-L51), then for each station plots a red-filled circle at (X(sta_j,sta_i),Y(sta_j,sta_i)) and a white label 'G<14-k>' offset from it (L52-L56). Finishes with caxis [-10 5], white dotted reference line, axis [30 765 250 950], colorbar, axis labels (L58-L63), and prints plots_movies/depth_station.jpg and .eps (L66-L67).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
DimsX — cell holding fread dimensions [m n] (L9)
station — station index table from station.txt (L11)
dep — depth field, reoriented, land NaN-ed (L18-L22, L46)
x — x coordinates registered to image (L29)
y — y coordinates registered to image, reversed (L30)

equations.ref: station label numbering G13 downward as k increases

io.name: bathymetry pcolor over image with station markers and labels

unresolved: Station labels are generated as G<14-k> (L54), i.e. G13, G12, ... for k=1,2,...; this presumes exactly 13 stations ordered opposite to the FRF gauge numbering — the actual number of rows in station.txt is not visible here, and if it is not 13 labels go wrong (G0, negative).

Label y-position uses Y(sta_j(k)-15,sta_i(k)) (L55) — an index offset of 15 rows — which errors if sta_j(k)<=15; also mixing an index offset (rows) with the -20 coordinate offset in x is inconsistent.
for k=1:length(station) (L52) uses length() of a matrix, which is max(rows,cols); correct only while the station count exceeds 2 columns.
Stale comments 'make up breaker and foam for visualization' and 'eta without breaker' (L42, L45) are leftovers from the sibling movie script and do not describe this code.
The +220 y-registration matches movie_eta_foam.m but differs from movie_mean_values.m (+180); which is correct for frf_03.jpg is not determinable here.
